chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Zurārah, from one of them, peace be upon them, who said:

If the traveler does not find water, then let him seek it so long as the time remains. فإذا he fears that the time will pass him by, then let him perform tayammum and pray at the end of the time. Then if he finds water, there is no making up the prayer upon him, and let him perform wudu for what he will face thereafter.

Then he said, may Allah the Exalted support him: Whoever stands for a salat with tayammum due to lack of water, then finds it after having begun it, then if he has said the takbirat al-ihram, there is no obligation upon him to leave the salat. But if he has not yet said it, then let him withdraw, purify himself, and then begin the salat anew, if Allah the Exalted wills.

The strongest indication of it is that the one performing tayammum is permitted to enter the salat with his tayammum; so once he has entered the salat, we do not obligate him to withdraw except with a proof that removes the excuse, and there is nothing here that removes the excuse, and that whoever enters the salat with tayammum and then finds water, it is obligatory upon him to withdraw from it.

key_terms.الِانْصِرَافُ: withdrawing or breaking off the salat
key_terms.الْمَاءَ: water required for wudu and ritual purification
key_terms.الْمُسَافِرُ: the traveler subject to this ruling
key_terms.الْوَقْتِ: the prescribed time of the salat
key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةَ الْإِحْرَامِ: the opening takbir that formally begins the salat
key_terms.فَلْيَتَيَمَّمْ: let him perform tayammum as a substitute purification
key_terms.قَضَاءَ: making up a prayer after its time
key_terms.وَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ: let him perform wudu for subsequent prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a traveler cannot find water and performs tayammum for salat, then later finds water?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the ruling of a traveler who cannot find water and must resort to tayammum for salat. It explains that he should continue searching while time remains, pray with tayammum near the end of the time if necessary, and not repeat that prayer if water is later found; it also addresses the case of finding water after beginning the prayer.
